tagline: A forested northern suburb popular with affluent Istanbul families — large villas, equestrian centres, and a complete retreat from urban life.

items.name: Zekeriyaköy Kahvaltı Bahçeleri
items.description: Garden breakfast spots and cafés in this leafy village popular on weekend mornings with families from across Istanbul.
items.tip: Weekend brunch here is a popular Istanbul ritual. Book ahead for garden restaurants on Sundays.

items.name: Ormanlı Yürüyüş Parkurları
items.description: Walking trails through the Belgrad Forest and surrounding woodland. Good for a proper forest escape near the city.

items.name: Atlı Spor Kulüpleri
items.description: Several equestrian clubs in the area offering riding lessons and facilities. Popular with families in the area.

tips: Zekeriyaköy is only accessible by car or taxi from Sarıyer metro. No direct public transport.
Best for weekend brunch or a forest walk — not a practical daily location without a car.
Housing is large villas rather than apartments. Very family-oriented and affluent.
Belgrad Forest (Istanbul's main forest park) is accessible from here by car.
